card.name: Words leading into time-span phrases
card.fires_on: Small linking words just before a length of time, such as 'during the previous 12 months', 'more than six months' or 'in the past year'. It also fires on 'ever had' before a lifetime-style question.

modes.label: Before a look-back period
modes.description: Words like during, previous, past, within the that lead into 'past/previous N months or year'.
modes.example: 4.4 percent reported having had a sexual experience with another woman<< during>> the previous 12 months.

modes.label: Duration thresholds
modes.description: Words like than or persisting that lead into a minimum length such as six months.
modes.example: that has lasted for more<< than>> six months.

modes.label: Ever-experience questions
modes.description: The word had after 'ever' in a question about whether something has ever happened.
modes.example: "Have you ever<< had>> any sexual experience of any kind with another

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words like lifetime and month as the next word.
card.plain: It marks the spot where a text is about to state a time period such as the past 12 months or a lifetime.
